name: Telepathy
description: The purported direct transmission of information from one mind to another without using any known sensory channel. Coined as a scientific term by Frederic W. H. Myers in 1882; treated by mainstream science as not demonstrated.

aliases.name: Mind reading
aliases.meaning: Popular term for purported direct mind-to-mind communication

aliases.name: Thought transference
aliases.meaning: Earlier 19th-century term used by SPR researchers before Myers coined 'telepathy'

aliases.name: Mental Radio
aliases.meaning: Title of Upton Sinclair's 1930 book; popular nickname for telepathy in the 1930s–40s

origin: Telepathy is reported and researched globally; experimental and theoretical work has been concentrated in the UK, USA, USSR/Russia, and continental Europe.
